performance_findings: Root causes: 1) requests routed to eu-west-1 despite NA-heavy traffic, 2) client-side timeout set to 2s and then retries causing head-of-line delay, 3) long prompts (avg 1.8k tokens) with excessive system/context repetition. SE notes: enabling streaming reduces UI latency; set client timeout to 6s for long-form but tune retries; recommend token trimming and prompt caching for static system content.
recommended_actions:
- Switch default region to us-east-1 or us-west-2 for NA traffic.
- Update client timeout policy: initial request timeout 8s, disable aggressive retries; implement exponential backoff.
- Use streaming responses for chat UI to provide partial responses early.
- Trim system prompts: move static policy text to KV cache, pass only dynamic context.
- Set max prompt tokens to 800 for checkout flow; use embeddings for doc lookups.
- Provide 30-day trial tokens and run A/B in prod with canary region for 2 weeks.
